title: Gundam Blitz Order Mobile Game Announced
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment announced the new Gundam Blitz Order "RPG-style idle simulation" mobile game on Thursday.

English video

Japanese video

Bandai Namco Entertainment is currently accepting applications for a network test for the game that will take place from November 18-24.

The company has opened an English website and X/Twitter account for the game.

Bandai Namco Entertainment describes the game:

With Gundam Blitz Order , we're taking on a new challenge for Gundam games by developing the series' first idle game. While there are many different styles of idle games, Gundam Blitz Order is an RPG-style idle simulation game where players collect and strengthen mobile suit units, increase their combat power, and build strategic formations while considering the unique battle styles of each unit. While some players may be new to the idle game genre, it offers unique benefits that help reduce the burden of gameplay. For example, upgrade materials which are used to strengthen units can be collected automatically, allowing players to progress more easily. We hope many players will enjoy this new take on a Gundam game.

In the game, players develop their own Mobile Suits, warships, and Mobile Armors from across the Gundam franchise, and build a team of these units to lead them to victory.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Adds English Dub for Saga of Tanya the Evil the Movie Anime
content:
Crunchyroll originally began streaming the film in September 2019.

Crunchyroll previously screened the film in more than 500 theaters in the United States in May 2019. It describes the story:

The time is UC 1926. The Imperial Army's 203rd Air Mage Battalion led by Major Tanya Degurechaff has won the battle to the south against the Republic's stragglers. They expected to be given a vacation after returning victorious, but instead receive special orders from Staff HQ as soon as they get home. They are told that there were signs of a large-scale deployment near the Empire-Federation border. Faced with the prospect of a new major enemy, the desperate Empire fans the flame of war. Meanwhile, an international volunteer army spearheaded by the Commonwealth set foot in Federation territory. As they say, the enemy of an enemy is your friend. They suffer through misfortune purely out of national interest, and among them is a young girl. She is Warrant Officer Mary Sue, and she takes up arms hoping to bring the Empire, who killed her father, to justice.

The film opened in Japan in February 2019.

Crunchyroll began streaming an English dub for The Saga of Tanya the Evil: Operation Desert Pasta special last month. The 17-minute short debuted during a livestreamed event for the franchise in June 2021. Crunchyroll added the short to its library in the same month.

The first television anime season premiered in January 2017. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and Funimation streamed an English dub.

Saga of Tanya the Evil II ( Yōjo Senki II ), the anime's second season , debuted on the AT-X channel on July 8. Crunchyroll is also streaming an English dub for the new season.
author: ANN

title: Fate/Extra Record Game Highlights Opponents in New Character Promo Video
content:
Aniplex revealed a new "RIVAL's SIDE" character promotional video for Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game, on Thursday. The video features the Masters and Servants of the opposing faction that players will fight during the Moon Holy Grail War. Aniplex also announced that the game will have a special 90-minute hands-on event on November 7 and 8 in Tokyo.

Aniplex also revealed the cast members for the Masters and Servants:

Hiroshi Kamiya as Shinji Matou

Urara Takano as Shinji's Servant

Ai Nonaka as Alice

Yū Kobayashi as Run Rū-kun (Lil' Ronnie)

Hisao Egawa as Run Rū-kun's servant

Wataru Hatano as Julius B. Harwey

Kunihiko Yasui as Julius B. Harwey's servant

Mugihito as Dan Blackmore

Kōsuke Toriumi as Dan Blackmore's servant

Kentarō Itō as Monji Gatou

Ikumi Hasegawa as Monji Gatou's servant

Romi Park as Leonardo B. Harwey

Daichū Mizushima as Leonardo B. Harwey's servant

Asami Sanada as Rani VIII

Kunihiko Yasui as Rani VIII's servant

Kana Ueda as Rin Tohsaka

Nobutoshi Canna as Rin Tohsaka's servant

The game will launch for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam on January 28, following several delays. Marvelous Europe will publish the game in Europe and Australia.

The game will get a physical Limited Edition that includes a 3-disc soundtrack, SteelBook case, and artbook. The Digital Deluxe Edition will include an arranged BGM pack, Servant and player outfits bundle, three outfit packs, a digital soundtrack, and artbook.

The game was slated for a release in spring this year after a previous delay from a 2025 release. Type-Moon studio BB announced the game in July 2020, in what was the 10th anniversary of the original Fate/Extra game.

Aniplex will now publish the game.

The game had been delayed indefinitely following a mutual agreement between Notes (the Type-Moon creative circle's official corporate and publishing name) and Bandai Namco Entertainment for the latter to pull out of publishing of the game. Type-Moon noted then that development on the game would continue, but the game's development structure would change.

The game's director and planner, and Type-Moon studio BB director Kazuya Nino left Type-Moon studio BB, due to personal reasons, and has also stepped down as Fate/Extra Record game's director and planner. Nino added that he will be taking a break from developing games due to current health concerns. Nino was the producer for Fate/Extra , and also worked on the first Etrian Odyssey game.

Arco Wada returns as the game's character designer.

Marvelous Entertainment and Type-Moon released the Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game in Japan in 2010. Aksys Games released the game in North America in November 2011. The Fate/Extra CCC companion game shipped in Japan on the PSP in March 2013. The games are set in an alternate science-fiction continuity of Type-Moon 's Fate universe, often referred to by fans as the "Extraverse."

The games inspired SHAFT 's 10-episode television anime Fate/Extra Last Encore in January 2018. Netflix began streaming the anime outside of Japan in June 2018. The three-episode Fate/Extra Last Encore: Illustrias Tendōsetsu (Illustrias Geocentrism) special then debuted in July 2018.

Marvelous released Fate/EXTELLA: The Umbral Star , an "Extraverse" game, for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita in November 2016. XSEED Games released the game in the West in January 2017, and on PC and Switch in July 2017. Fate/EXTELLA LINK , an enhanced version of the game, shipped in Japan in June 2018, and XSEED Games released the game in March 2019.

Koei Tecmo launched the action RPG Fate/Samurai Remnant in September 2023. The game is available worldwide for PS5, PS4, PC via Steam , and Switch.

title: 'Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san?' Anime Announces January 7 Debut
content:
The anime will debut in the "Super Animeism Turbo" programming block on MBS , TBS , and 26 affiliated channels, and it will run on Thursdays at 00:26 (effectively, Fridays at 12:26 a.m.) The staff had previously announced that the anime would air in 2026.

The anime stars:

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Mai Chihara

• Kazuki Ura as Kuroki

• Maaya Uchida as Chinatsu Iwakura

• Tomokazu Sugita as Hibiya

• Daisuke Ono as Kazami

Yasuaki Fujii (episode director for Teasing Master Takagi-san , Too Cute Crisis , Aikatsu! ) is directing the anime at Synergy SP . Keiichirō Ōchi ( Aikatsu! , Summer Pockets , The Quintessential Quintuplets ) is overseeing the series scripts. Majiro ( Macross Delta , UniteUp! ) is designing the characters, and Arisa Okehazama ( The Apothecary Diaries , Jujutsu Kaisen , DIGIMON BEATBREAK ) is composing the music at King Records .

Seven Seas Entertainment has licensed the manga for English release, and it describes the story:

It's the start of a new semester, and high school junior Kuroki finds himself seated beside the girl everyone whispers about: Mai Chihara. With her gothic fashion, jet-black hair, and intense stare, Chihara is said to be a “landmine” girl or jirai-kei, the hyper-feminine, dark aesthetic often associated with yandere tendencies and unstable personalities. But when Kuroki accidentally draws Chihara's attention, he discovers she isn't nearly as unstable as people claim. Beneath the intimidating aura is a surprisingly sweet girl… if a little weird.

Ryon launched the manga on the GANMA! service in June 2021. The manga won a "Next Impact Comic" award at the second Rakuten Kobo E-book Awards in 2024.
author: ANN

title: Bless TV Anime Casts Kōki Uchiyama
content:
The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed in a character promotional video on Thursday that Kōki Uchiyama voices Akiharu Nakano in the series.

The anime will star:

• Tomohiro Ōno as Aia Udagawa

• Chiyuki Miura as Jun Sumisaki

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Ginga Yoyogi

• Yoshino Aoyama as Oroka Sumeragi

• Momoka Terasawa as Shitataka Sumeragi

• Kentarō Kumagai as MM

• Yoshiki Nakajima as Joe Osaki

Shōtarō Kitamura ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! ) is directing the anime at A-1 Pictures , and Takayuki Kikuchi (episode director for Solo Leveling , Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is the assistant director. Fukurou Kamiza ( Non Non Biyori Nonstop ) is writing and overseeing the series scripts. Honoka Yokoyama ( Oshi no Ko TV 2 , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is both the character designer and chief animation director, and Tetsuya Kawakami ( A Certain Magical Index , Sword Art Online ) and Reina Iwasaki ( VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream ) are also chief animation directors. Ryō Yoshimata ( Somali and the Forest Spirit , After the Rain ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Costume Design: Akane Takeda (A-1 Pictures)

• Prop Design: Takayuki Kidou

• Main Animators: Yūichirō Iida, Marina Kobayashi, Mirai Harashima (A-1 Pictures)

• Hair and Makeup Supervisor: Katsuyoshi Kojima (tron)

• Graphic Illustration: Kashimaki

• Color Design: Mana Hokuto (A-1 Pictures)

• Art Director: Risa Wakabayashi (A-1 Pictures)

• Background Art: Kiya Hirayoshi (A-1 Pictures)

• CG Director: Yuki Kuribayashi

• Director of Photography: Hideki Eto (EXPLOSION)

• Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Director: Kōhei Yoshida

• Sound Effects: Takuya Hasegawa

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English and it describes the story:

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

Sonoyama debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge magazine in 2022, and the series now runs in Monthly Shonen Sirius . Kodansha published the ninth volume on October 8. The manga has more than 1.25 million copies in circulation.

Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga's seventh volume on February 10. Kodansha is also releasing the manga digitally on its K MANGA service.

The manga is also inspiring a live-action series that Amazon Prime Video will stream worldwide exclusively in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: Kei Urana's Gachiakuta Manga Resumes on November 11
content:
Manga creator Kei Urana revealed on X (formerly Twitter ) on Thursday that the Gachiakuta manga will return from hiatus on November 11.

Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine commented on September 8 on the ongoing hiatus of the manga. Kodansha stated then it would announce the manga's return once it was decided.

The magazine last published a new chapter for Gachiakuta in this year's 36th and 37th combined issue that shipped on August 5. The magazine's website for all issues since then has stated the manga was on hiatus so that Urana could conduct research.

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Rudo lives in the slums of a floating town, where the poor scrape by under the shadow of the rich who live a sumptuous life, simply casting their garbage off the side, into the abyss. Then one day, he's falsely accused of murder, and his wrongful conviction leads to an unimaginable punishment—exile off the edge, with the rest of the trash. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has bred vicious monsters, and if Rudo wants to have any hope of discovering the truth and seeking vengeance against those who cast him into Hell, he will have to master a new power and join a group known as the Cleaners who battle the hulking trash beasts of the Pit!

Urana launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in February 2022. Hideyoshi Ando is credited for graffiti design. Kodansha published the manga's 19th compiled book volume on July 16.

The manga's television anime adaptation premiered in Japan in July 2025 on CBC , TBS , and 26 other channels. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime in the following territories: North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS (excluding Russia and Belarus), and the Indian subcontinent. Crunchyroll is also streaming an English dub for the series.

The anime will get a second season.
author: ANN

title: 'Isekai de Cheat Skill wo Te ni Shita Ore wa, Genjitsu Sekai wo mo Musou Suru 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, New Staff, First Promo for Winter 2027
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Miku 's Isekai de Cheat Skill wo Te ni Shita Ore wa, Genjitsu Sekai wo mo Musou Suru: Level Up wa Jinsei wo Kaeta ( I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too ) light novel revealed a pair of additional cast, new staff, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video for the second season on Thursday. The anime series will premiere on Tokyo MX, BS11, and other stations in January 2027.

Voice actors Ikumi Hasegawa ( 86 ) and Sora Amamiya ( Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! ) are joining the cast as Iris Noublade and Mai Kagurazaka, respectively.

Staff Director: Shin Itagaki ( Isekai de Cheat Skill wo Te ni Shita Ore wa, Genjitsu Sekai wo mo Musou Suru chief director) NEW Character Design: Hiromi Kimura ( Kimi to Koete Koi ni Naru ) Art Director: Hirofumi Sakagami ( Isekai Nonbiri Nouka ) NEW , Kuniyuki Suzuki ( Nihon e Youkoso Elf-san. assistant art Director) NEW Art Design: Hiroshi Katou ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: GQuuuuuuX ) NEW , Yuichi Asami ( Mao ) NEW Color Design: Aiko Yamagami ( Berserk ), Junko Nagaoka (Sai Labo) Director of Photography: Arimasa Yoshimi ( Cop Craft ) NEW , Kotonari Hoashi NEW 3D CG Director: Baku Ikeda NEW Editing: Haruka Nunokawa NEW Sound Director: Ryousuke Naya ( Maou Gakuin no Futekigousha ), Shin Itagaki ( Kumo desu ga, Nani ka? ) Music: Akiyuki Tateyama ( Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsuujinai ), SHIKI ( Meiji Tokyo Renka ) NEW Planning, Production: Unlimited Produce by TMS Studio: Millepensee

Note: The staff denoted with the legend NEW are new in their respective roles.

Produced by Millepensee, the first 13-episode season aired in Spring 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series with subtitles and dubs in multiple languages.

Miku began penning the light novel—also known as Iseleve —on the Kakuyomu website in March 2017, approximately three years after launching Shinka no Mi: Shiranai Uchi ni Kachigumi Jinsei ( The Fruit of Evolution: Before I Knew It, My Life Had It Made! ). Kadokawa began releasing the series with illustrations by Rein Kuwashima under its Fantasia Bunko imprint in December 2018. The 21th volume was published on September 18.

Kazuomi Minatogawa ( M3: Sono Kuroki Hagane ) began drawing a manga adaptation on the Web DenPlay Comic website in December 2019. Kadokawa released the seventh volume in December 2025.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and manga in English in September 2021 and released the eighth light novel volume on September 22. The sixth manga volume was published in November 2025, with the seventh volume scheduled for February 2027.

contentBlocks.text: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Miku 's Isekai de Cheat Skill wo Te ni Shita Ore wa, Genjitsu Sekai wo mo Musou Suru: Level Up wa Jinsei wo Kaeta ( I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too ) light novel revealed a pair of additional cast, new staff, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video for the second season on Thursday. The anime series will premiere on Tokyo MX, BS11, and other stations in January 2027.
Voice actors Ikumi Hasegawa ( 86 ) and Sora Amamiya ( Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! ) are joining the cast as Iris Noublade and Mai Kagurazaka, respectively.

Staff Director: Shin Itagaki ( Isekai de Cheat Skill wo Te ni Shita Ore wa, Genjitsu Sekai wo mo Musou Suru chief director) NEW Character Design: Hiromi Kimura ( Kimi to Koete Koi ni Naru ) Art Director: Hirofumi Sakagami ( Isekai Nonbiri Nouka ) NEW , Kuniyuki Suzuki ( Nihon e Youkoso Elf-san. assistant art Director) NEW Art Design: Hiroshi Katou ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: GQuuuuuuX ) NEW , Yuichi Asami ( Mao ) NEW Color Design: Aiko Yamagami ( Berserk ), Junko Nagaoka (Sai Labo) Director of Photography: Arimasa Yoshimi ( Cop Craft ) NEW , Kotonari Hoashi NEW 3D CG Director: Baku Ikeda NEW Editing: Haruka Nunokawa NEW Sound Director: Ryousuke Naya ( Maou Gakuin no Futekigousha ), Shin Itagaki ( Kumo desu ga, Nani ka? ) Music: Akiyuki Tateyama ( Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsuujinai ), SHIKI ( Meiji Tokyo Renka ) NEW Planning, Production: Unlimited Produce by TMS Studio: Millepensee
Note: The staff denoted with the legend NEW are new in their respective roles.
Produced by Millepensee, the first 13-episode season aired in Spring 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series with subtitles and dubs in multiple languages.

Miku began penning the light novel—also known as Iseleve —on the Kakuyomu website in March 2017, approximately three years after launching Shinka no Mi: Shiranai Uchi ni Kachigumi Jinsei ( The Fruit of Evolution: Before I Knew It, My Life Had It Made! ). Kadokawa began releasing the series with illustrations by Rein Kuwashima under its Fantasia Bunko imprint in December 2018. The 21th volume was published on September 18.
Kazuomi Minatogawa ( M3: Sono Kuroki Hagane ) began drawing a manga adaptation on the Web DenPlay Comic website in December 2019. Kadokawa released the seventh volume in December 2025.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and manga in English in September 2021 and released the eighth light novel volume on September 22. The sixth manga volume was published in November 2025, with the seventh volume scheduled for February 2027.

title: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World 2nd Season Anime Reveals Teaser Video, New, Returning Cast & Staff, January 2027 Debut
content:
Kadokawa revealed on Thursday the first teaser promotional video, first key visual, returning and new cast and staff members, and January 2027 debut for the second season of the anime based on Miku and illustrator Rein Kuwashima 's I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World ( Isekai de Cheat Skill o Te ni Shita Ore wa, Genjitsu Sekai o mo Musōsuru ) light novel series.

New cast members for the second season are:

Ikumi Hasegawa as Iris Knowblade

Sora Amamiya as Mai Kagurazaka

Returning cast members include:

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Yūya Tenjō

• Akari Kitō as Kaori Hōjō

• Kaori Maeda as Lexia von Arcelia

• Ai Kakuma as Luna

• Rina Hidaka as Yuti

• Marina Inoue as Kuro

The first I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World anime chief director Shin Itagaki is returning to direct the new season at Millepensee . Hiromi Kimura also returns to design the characters, and UNLIMITED PRODUCE by TMS is again in charge of planning and production.

Additional returning and new staff members are:

• Art Directors: Hirofumi Sakagami, Kuniyuki Suzuki

• Art Setting: Hiroshi Katō, Yuichi Asami

• Color Design: Aiko Yamagami, Junko Nagaoka

• Compositing Directors of Photography: Arimasa Omi (new), Kotonari Hoashi (new)

• CG Director: Baku Ikeda

• Editing: Haruka Nunokawa

• Sound Directors: Ryōsuke Naya, Shin Itagaki

• Music: Akiyuki Tateyama, SHIKI (new)

The first anime premiered in April 2023 and aired for 13 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and also streamed an English dub . The franchise 's television special streamed on March 29 and then aired on March 30.

Yen Press is releasing the light novels and manga adaptation in English, and it describes the story:

A door to another world stretches out before a boy who's been brutally bullied all his life. This alternate reality grants him access to all sorts of things, like cheat skills and a portal that lets him travel between his old and new worlds! Can this class loser turn his life around back home...?

The book franchise has 4 million copies in circulation, including spinoffs.

The franchise has a browser game titled Isekai de Cheat Skill o Te ni Shita Ore wa, Genjitsu Sekai o mo Musōsuru - Level Up wa Jinsei o Kaeta : Parallel Universe . The MMORPG debuted worldwide in Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, and Korean on the G123 platform in July 2024. The game is free to play but has optional in-game purchases.

title: Firefly Wedding TV Anime Casts Kanon Amane
content:
The X (formerly Twitter ) account for the television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding manga revealed a new cast member on Thursday. Kanon Amane will voice Yukari, a courtesan at the "Isekichi" brothel.

The anime stars Lynn as Satoko Kirigaya and Kōki Uchiyama as Shinpei Gotō. Additional cast members include Kent Itō as Kōtarō Ogawa and Kenjirō Tsuda as Mitsueda.

Takahiro Kamei (2022-2024's Urusei Yatsura ) is directing the anime at david production , and Yukiko Aikei ( Horizon in the Middle of Nowhere , Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop , Your Lie in April ) is designing the characters. Yūko Kakihara (2022-2024 Urusei Yatsura series, IRODUKU: The World in Colors , Blue Box ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts, and NOGRID is composing the music.

iri performs the opening theme song "Period," and TOOBOE performs the anime's ending theme song "Yumegokochi" (Trance).

Viz Media publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

On the surface, Satoko has it all—she's beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family's eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

Tachibana launched the manga on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app in January 2023, and Shogakukan published the 12th compiled book volume on June 19.

The manga is also inspiring a live-action television adaptation that is slated to debut in 2027.
